title: Career Assistant
subtitle: Turn job alerts into an evidence-based application shortlist.
chooseOrg: Choose a workspace to open your private career assistant.
summary: Professional summary (only facts you can support)
keywordsHint: Separate keywords with commas. Matching uses exact terms: include English and Arabic variants. Language checks currently recognise English names.
gmailDescription: Read LinkedIn and Indeed alerts from the last 14 days. Flow does not send applications or modify email.
gmailNotConfigured: Gmail is not configured on this server. You can import alert text below.
connected: Gmail connected. Choose Sync now or enable daily sync.
consentDenied: Gmail permission was declined or the callback is incomplete. Try connecting again.
dailySync: Enable a daily inbox check and in-app notification
pasteHint: Paste a LinkedIn or Indeed alert with its direct job links. Unsupported formats are reported.
imported: Imported {{count}} new jobs. Existing jobs were preserved.
rankingNote: The score measures keyword evidence and known gaps, not acceptance probability. Missing requirements need review. OTE, estimates and unknown salary periods do not receive salary points.
empty: No jobs in this view. Import an alert or sync Gmail to start.
noEvidence: No explicit keyword match yet. Add your profile or check the full listing.
draftNote: Review every statement, replace your name and attach your CV yourself. Nothing has been sent.

salaryKind.listed_unverified: Listed amount — confirm guaranteed pay with employer
salaryKind.commission_or_ote: Commission / target earnings — not guaranteed salary

unparsed: {{count}} messages had no supported job links; review the original alerts.
